summary: Shutterstock filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.36 per common share, declared by the Board on April 20, 2026, with a June 4 record date and June 18 payment date. The filing contains no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situations event; it is a standard capital-return announcement. This is a non-event from a special-situations standpoint. No deal terms are present, and there is no risk-arb angle.
